evidenceSummary: The existing Stage 1-1 census records current scheduleType values new, single, dual, triple, and wish.

The existing validator applies different image behavior to those five legacy scheduleType values, confirming that scheduleType is an implementation/display field rather than a clean canonical semantic enum.
The current schedule contains NEW examples with different hero counts, including 9601 and 9701, so NEW cannot safely encode pickup cardinality.
The current schedule contains collaboration banner 9801 as scheduleType=new, so COLLAB is cross-cutting context rather than a mutually exclusive mechanic.
Stage 1-2 already proved sourceType=new can appear in a later scheduleType=single occurrence, so source classification and occurrence taxonomy must remain separate.

Project design requires CP pickup logs, wish selectable lists, special-banner explanation, and single-pickup rerun history; only wish and single-rerun semantics are directly aligned with current schedule evidence, while CP remains relation-level review.
decision: Stage 1-3 passes. The provisional taxonomy is intentionally multi-axis: mechanicFamily, lifecycle, pickupCardinality, and non-exclusive contextTags. This removes the semantic mixing present in legacy scheduleType while preserving sourceType and all unresolved states. It is investigation taxonomy only and must not yet replace production fields.

priorities: Banner occurrence -> CardPool source relation correctness
CardPool/source -> explicit Hero ID relations using canonical Hero identity
Event relation presence/cardinality only if evidenced
Resolve or formally repair kr-banner:20270331:4 source conflict before production consumer generation
